entry.title: libsecp256k1 v0.8.0 released
entry.summary:
The latest version 0.8.0 of libsecp256k1 has been released, marking significant updates and improvements in its functionality. This new release can be accessed on GitHub at [libsecp256k1 v0.8.0](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/secp256k1/releases/tag/v0.8.0), where the full details of the update are available for review.
A key enhancement in this version is the introduction of the Silent Payments module, as outlined in BIP 352. This module enhances privacy by supporting silent payment functionalities on full nodes. Another notable improvement includes the addition of a new function that allows users to override the internal SHA256 compression function. This is particularly beneficial for integrating hardware-optimized SHA256 implementations, which can significantly boost performance.
Performance optimizations have also been implemented, particularly in the 64-bit field element implementation. These optimizations have led to considerable speed increases in many library functions when compiled with GCC and MSVC. For instance, ECDSA and Schnorr signature verification functions have seen speedups of up to approximately 11%. Moreover, certain deprecated symbols like `secp256k1_schnorrsig_sign` and `secp256k1_context_no_precomp` have been removed in favor of updated alternatives, streamlining the library's functionality.
For those interested in the detailed list of changes, the complete changelog is available at [libsecp256k1 Changelog](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/secp256k1/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md). This documentation provides an exhaustive overview of all modifications, enhancements, and removals included in this release. This version represents a substantial step forward in the development of the libsecp256k1 library, reflecting ongoing efforts to refine and enhance its capabilities.
